method: Actual clicks with canvas screenshot and URL observation; screenshots inspected in conversation, not archived as PNG files

observations.during: Following text and lower controls moved down; disclosure faded at its destination position, creating transient overlap at slow diagnostic duration
observations.end: Source disclosure and following content were separately readable; Hide source, error, Back and Restart controls visible

observations.during: Following content stayed at its source position early in the transition and later appeared at the destination while other matching controls moved; qualitative comparison is consistent with dissolve instead of position interpolation

observations.finding: Navigate to closed retains history; resetInteractiveComponents does not erase navigation history

observations.action: R shortcut shown on the Restart button

observations.finding: Restart button automation sometimes left unchanged or black canvas. BACK at an empty history also showed a black canvas. These observations do not establish a general Figma defect; do not treat URL changes alone as successful rendering.
Back and inactive At start pseudo-button hidden on closed frame; final closed/open states rendered correctly and R returned to closed

limitations: Qualitative canvas observations; not frame-by-frame animation timing measurement
Presentation Restart button clicks were unreliable in this automation run; R shortcut verified twice
No screen-reader audit, production backend, or OS reduced-motion setting test
